facetedcategory-faceted-categories:
Heading of the list of faceted categories (categories whose names look like "Facet/Member") shown below the page, before the core list of the other categories ({{msg-mw|Pagecategories}}). It links to [[Special:FacetedCategories]].
{{Identical|Faceted Categories}}
facetedcategory-general-categories: Replaces the heading {{msg-mw|Pagecategories}} of the list of categories without a facet (categories whose names have no slash), shown below the list headed {{msg-mw|Facetedcategory-faceted-categories}}.
facetedcategory-combinations: Heading of the list of category combinations suggested below the page, after {{msg-mw|Facetedcategory-faceted-categories}}. It links to [[Special:FacetedCategories]], and so does each item, for the pages in all the categories of that combination.
facetedcategory-combination-invalid: Error shown in place of the {{#categorycombination:name|category|category}} parser function when it lacks a name or has fewer than two categories.
facetedcategory-ve-page-facets: Heading in the suggestions of the VisualEditor category input, shown while the input is empty, above the facets of the categories the page already has. Choosing a facet fills the input with it, followed by a slash, to suggest its members.
facetedcategory-ve-common-facets: Heading in the suggestions of the VisualEditor category input, shown while the input is empty, above the facets in which pages are categorized the most. See also {{msg-mw|facetedcategory-ve-page-facets}}.
facetedcategory-intro: Text at the top of [[Special:FacetedCategories]], above a box to find categories and a card for each facet.
facetedcategory-all-members:
Link at the bottom of the card of a facet on [[Special:FacetedCategories]], to the list of all its members.

Parameters:
* $1 - number of members of the facet
facetedcategory-other-facets: Heading on [[Special:FacetedCategories]] above the links to the facets without a card, after the cards of the facets with the most pages.
facetedcategory-facet-summary:
Text below the title of [[Special:FacetedCategories]] when it lists the members of a facet.

Parameters:
* $1 - number of members
* $2 - number of pages in all the members, a page in two members counted twice
facetedcategory-filter: Placeholder and label of the input which filters the members of a facet on [[Special:FacetedCategories]].
facetedcategory-filter-submit:
Button which filters and sorts the members of a facet on [[Special:FacetedCategories]].
{{Identical|Show}}
facetedcategory-sort-pages: Option to list the members of a facet with the most pages first, on [[Special:FacetedCategories]]. See also {{msg-mw|facetedcategory-sort-name}}.
facetedcategory-sort-name: Option to list the members of a facet in alphabetical order, on [[Special:FacetedCategories]]. See also {{msg-mw|facetedcategory-sort-pages}}.
facetedcategory-member: Column heading of the members of a facet on [[Special:FacetedCategories]].
facetedcategory-pages:
Column heading of the numbers of pages of the members of a facet on [[Special:FacetedCategories]].
{{Identical|Page}}
facetedcategory-no-members: Shown on [[Special:FacetedCategories]] when no member of a facet matches the filter, or the facet has none.
facetedcategory-find: Placeholder and label of the box at the top of [[Special:FacetedCategories]], in which one finds categories to see the pages in all of them.
facetedcategory-add: Placeholder and label of the input after the chosen categories on [[Special:FacetedCategories]], to add one more.
facetedcategory-add-submit:
Button after {{msg-mw|facetedcategory-add}} or {{msg-mw|facetedcategory-find}}, for browsers without JavaScript.
{{Identical|Add}}
facetedcategory-show-intersection: Button below the members of a facet on [[Special:FacetedCategories]], to show the pages in all the checked members.
facetedcategory-needs-category: Error on [[Special:FacetedCategories]] when all the given categories are ones the pages must not be in.
facetedcategory-condition:
A faceted category in the title of [[Special:FacetedCategories]] when it shows the pages in several categories.

Parameters:
* $1 - the facet
* $2 - the member
facetedcategory-excluded: Shown before a category the pages are not in, in the list of chosen categories on [[Special:FacetedCategories]].
facetedcategory-named-combination: Shown below the title of [[Special:FacetedCategories]] when it shows the pages of a category combination which editors named with {{#categorycombination:}}, the name being the title. Followed by {{msg-mw|facetedcategory-result-count}}.
facetedcategory-result-count:
Number of pages in all the chosen categories on [[Special:FacetedCategories]].

Parameters:
* $1 - number of pages
facetedcategory-result-count-more:
Shown instead of {{msg-mw|facetedcategory-result-count}} when there are too many pages to count.

Parameters:
* $1 - the most pages counted
facetedcategory-no-results: Shown on [[Special:FacetedCategories]] when no page is in all the chosen categories.
facetedcategory-exclude:
Tooltip of a chosen category on [[Special:FacetedCategories]]; clicking it shows the pages not in it.

Parameters:
* $1 - the category
facetedcategory-include:
Tooltip of a category the pages are not in on [[Special:FacetedCategories]]; clicking it shows the pages in it.

Parameters:
* $1 - the category
facetedcategory-remove:
Label of the button removing a chosen category on [[Special:FacetedCategories]].

Parameters:
* $1 - the category
{{Identical|Remove}}
